info.title: r16a-stream API
info.description: Private streaming API. See docs/SPEC.md section 5.

Starts a single-part upload of a manual poster or backdrop for a title, or a still for an
episode. Completing it through `/admin/uploads/{id}/complete` attaches the image.

Not an admin

409.description: Not failed or cancelled, or a newer job runs

404.description: No such title, or not an admin

get.summary:
Prefills a title draft from TMDB. Nothing is saved, the admin edits the draft and posts it
to `POST /admin/titles`.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description:
A TMDB link (`https://www.themoviedb.org/movie/603`, `/tv/1396-breaking-bad`) or a
numeric id together with `kind`.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: `movie` or `show`, needed with a numeric id.

400.description: Not a TMDB link or id

404.description: Unknown on TMDB, or not an admin

get.summary: An upload with the parts Garage holds, for resuming.

404.description: No such upload, or not an admin

delete.summary: Aborts an open upload and releases its reservation.

404.description: No such upload, or not an admin

post.summary: Completes the upload, checks its size and queues the transcode.

400.description: Parts missing or wrong, or the stored size differs

404.description: No such upload, or not an admin

409.description: The upload is no longer open, or a job runs

post.summary: Presigned part URLs on the app's origin, one hour, at most 50 per call.

404.description: No such upload, or not an admin

409.description: The upload is no longer open

post.summary: Ends every web session of a user now and refuses their mobile tokens issued until now.
post.description:
It is not a ban. A user still in `r16a-stream-users` can sign in again, removing them from
the group in Authentik is the ban (OPERATING 8).

get.summary: Finishes the web login, sets the session cookie and returns to the app.

302.description: Signed in, redirect to the saved path. On failure, redirect to the sign-in page with an error

429.description: Too many login attempts from this address

get.summary: Starts the web login and redirects to Authentik.

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description: Same-origin path to return to after login. Anything else is replaced by `/`.

302.description: Redirect to the Authentik authorize endpoint, sets the flow cookie

429.description: Too many login attempts from this address

post.summary: Ends the web session, revokes its refresh token and clears the cookie.

get.summary: All genres, with the slug the clients translate.
Up to 20 titles added most recently, for the home row.
Content languages that at least one published title can be watched in.
The signed-in user. Provisions the user on a first mobile call.

patch.summary: Changes theme, UI language or preferred audio language.

get.summary: Lets the web app check that the API is reachable through the same origin.
Home grid, filters and search (H1 to H5).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words. Present means relevance order, `sort` is ignored.

get.summary: The title page (H8). Drafts are 404 here, admins see them through the admin routes.

404.description: No such published title
No such published title or season

still.description: Left out when there is no ready image.

AdminTitle.description: Everything an admin edits on one title, drafts included.

backdrop.description: Left out when there is no ready image.

poster.description: Left out when there is no ready image.

openUploadId.description: An upload that can still be resumed.

sourceBytes.description: Bytes of the source while it is kept.

sourceKept.description: A re-transcode needs the source. False once retention deleted it.

encoder.description: The worker's encoder, `x264 (fallback)` when Quick Sync failed its test.

languages.description: Content languages with a ready variant. Filled once variants exist (Phase 4).

still.description: Left out when there is no ready image.

name.description: Fallback when the client has no translation.

slug.description: Also the translation key `genre.<slug>` in the clients.

GenreInput.description:
A genre that may not exist yet, from TMDB or typed by an admin. Matched by `tmdbId` when set,
otherwise by the slug derived from the name.

ImageSet.description: Responsive image, presigned per UTC day (SPEC 8.3). Null until images arrive in Phase 3b.

placeholderHsl.description: HSL triple for the skeleton, for example `160 84% 39%`.

kind.description: `poster` or `backdrop` for a title, `still` for an episode.

partUrl.description: Presigned PUT of the single part, valid one hour. Never log it.

endSessionUrl.description:
Authentik's end-session endpoint. The browser navigates there so the Authentik session
ends too, and the provider's logout flow sends it back to the app. Null when Authentik
is unreachable, the local session is gone either way.

isAdmin.description:
The admin claim of this request's session or token. The admin area in the clients is
a convenience, the API checks admin rights on every admin route.

preferredAudioLanguage.description: BCP 47 tag of the audio language to prefer, null for none.

url.description: Presigned PUT on the app's own origin, valid one hour. Never log it.

SeasonPatch.description: Fields of a season or episode patch. Left out means unchanged, null clears.

SettingsPatch.description: Fields left out stay as they are. `preferredAudioLanguage: null` clears the preference.

StatusResponse.description: Answer of `GET /api/v1/status`. Deliberately free of versions and hostnames.

apiVersion.description: Major version of this API, the `v1` in the path.

degraded.description: Some component cannot write to Garage right now.

warning.description: Free space minus reservations below the warning threshold, or capacity unknown.

poster.description: Left out when there is no ready image.

backdrop.description: Left out when there is no ready image.

languages.description: Content languages with at least one ready variant.

poster.description: Left out when there is no ready image.

TitleInput.description: A whole title as an admin saves it, or as the TMDB lookup proposes it.

posterPath.description:
TMDB file path of the poster, for example `/kU3B75TyRiCgE270EyZnHjfivoq.jpg`. The API
downloads it on save (SPEC 8.2).

seasons.description: Shows only. Create only, later changes go through the season and episode routes.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.

TitlePatch.description:
Fields of a title that `PATCH /admin/titles/{id}` may change. Left out means unchanged.
`genreIds`, `newGenres` and `credits` replace the whole set when present.

posterPath.description: A TMDB file path replaces the image, null removes it.

TitleStorage.description: Per-title storage and the editor's variant list (SPEC 7.10).

durationSeconds.description: Read from the file by the browser when it can, 10 s to 8 h, for the space estimate.

UploadState.description: An upload with the parts Garage already holds, for resuming.

episodeId.description: Required for shows, absent for movies.

language.description: Content language, BCP 47, for example `it` or `pt-BR`.
